steps.what: Find and read the chosen developmental game's existing activity card in {DOCS}.
Organize actual space, equipment, groups and access support for the game.
Supervise games or recreational activities to promote physical, mental or social development.
Adjust rules, support and breaks to actual participation and safety needs.

tasks.design: Configure a direct topic link to the actual game card in {DOCS}. The teacher retains activity selection, physical organisation, supervision and response-based adjustment; no new game report, pupil score or completion record is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: An existing card may take repeated folder navigation to reach.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links can remove that navigation without making instructional decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Inclusive participation and safety need observation and flexible support.
tasks.human_edge: Help a child participate successfully when the original game rules do not fit.
tasks.altitude: One small lookup chore changes; instructional and supervisory rights stay the same.

evidence.claim: Native activity-card links can reduce lookup navigation while game organisation and supervision remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is a real game using an existing card, not writing a new game plan each time. No separate written output is established for this encounter; no trailing progress register or attendance record is invented.

The actual teaching-material owner already produces activity title, goal, guidance and document link. S1 counts actual selection and reading; the native link only removes repeated navigation. Physical materials and student information are handled in s2, not supplied as a free structured feed.
Test native links first. S1 loses1 provisional hour of navigation, retaining9 of reading and selection; all90 organisation/supervision/adjustment hours remain. Existing direct links have no saving.
unknowns: Whether the game uses a written card at all
research_questions: Is the existing card routinely searched for, or already directly at hand?

already_counted.description: Activity selection/read, physical organisation, supervision and adaptive support

incremental.description: Maintain activity-card link when its existing location changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R99 gives1 gross less0.2 upkeep=0.8 net for actual repeated card navigation. Low0 retains the full task for familiar games without card lookup or an already direct card, adding no link upkeep. No live activity time is cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer standardized tests to elementary students with special needs

steps.what: Confirm the actual student, test version and permitted access arrangements.
Prepare actual test materials, accessible space and prescribed administration conditions.
Administer standardized ability or achievement tests, observing actual access needs and protocol deviations.
outputs: Actual test responses and administration observations

steps.what: Capture actual responses, completion and deviations in the assessment-system category of {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual test responses and administration observations
outputs: Actual assessment administration record and native export

steps.what: Re-enter the actual administration metadata in the pupil-record draft panel in {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual assessment administration record and native export

steps.what: Check imported identity, version, date and completion against actual administration, repairing missing or mismatched fields.
inputs: Actual assessment administration record and native export

steps.what: Save the ordinary administration record in the pupil file.

tasks.design: Where actual assessment administration is recorded in one application and repeated in the pupil file, configure a native metadata import between those categories of {OTHER}. The teacher still administers the test, captures actual responses and deviations, and reconciles the imported draft; no score, educational level or placement is decided.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessment administration records and pupil records can require literal duplicate entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native supported exports/imports may remove that exact metadata transfer.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently complete test may be invalid because an access arrangement changed what was measured.
tasks.human_edge: Support the student while preserving and documenting the actual administration conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate administration metadata entry; assessment decisions and direct testing stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native assessment metadata transfer can remove duplicate entry without administering, scoring or interpreting a standardized test.

assumptions: Conditional boundary is actual administration with a genuine second pupil-record entry. No new completion register is introduced. Test scoring, grading and placement are outside this administration action and receive no claimed benefit here.

The teacher produces actual responses and administration facts in s3 and captures the primary record in s4, fully counted. Native metadata includes student id, test id/version, date, completion and deviation reference. Missing fields and unsupported export formats remain manually entered in s6; no clean input, transcript or unseen pupil response is assumed free.

Test native import first. S5 removes only actual second-system re-key into a draft panel. S6 keeps full identity and meaning/deviation checks plus failed-import repair. S7 is an ordinary internal record save,1 fully retained with no self-gate; it does not certify a grade or activate a placement.
unknowns: Compatible native metadata export and import
research_questions: Can native transfer preserve test version and deviation references without asserting a valid score?

already_counted.description: Identity and conditions, setup, actual test administration/capture, reconciliation and failed-import repairs

incremental.description: Maintain metadata mapping and check altered assessment export versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gives12 gross less1 upkeep=11 net for actual compatible second-system re-key. Low0 retains all manual metadata handling for paper-only or unsupported assessments and adds no import upkeep. Already linked systems have no duplicate-entry benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and supervise experiential learning activities

steps.what: Choose actual experiential learning goals and verify venue access, support and safeguarding feasibility.
Coordinate actual arrangements and access requirements with staff and the venue or guest.
Write the actual activity plan and support arrangements in {DOCS}.
Prepare the actual parent notice using the confirmed activity plan in {DOCS}.
Check final parent notice details, attachments, disclosure and actual recipients before release.
outputs: Approved final parent notice and recipients

steps.what: Send the exact approved notice through the existing parent-communication category of {OTHER}.
inputs: Approved final parent notice and recipients

steps.what: Resolve actual parent responses, staffing and access changes before the activity.
Supervise the actual experiential learning activity, supporting participation and safety.

tasks.design: Reuse the existing activity-plan structure and notice fields in {DOCS}; repeat only confirmed general logistics, never individual support needs, in the parent notice. The teacher retains arrangements, actual access checks, final notice release through {OTHER}, response handling and live supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual plans and notices can repeat structure and confirmed general logistics.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates and linked fields can remove those exact repetitions.
tasks.still_hard: A feasible plan can become unsafe or inaccessible when actual staffing, access or consent changes.
tasks.human_edge: Make the experience meaningful and manageable for the children actually participating.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less plan/notice setup; all educational and safety decisions stay with people.

evidence.claim: Native plan structures and linked notice fields can remove repeated logistical typing without replacing trip planning or supervision.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual local free visit or hosted activity with a written plan and required parent notice. It includes no purchase, supplier booking or transport order; none is silently automated. A classroom demonstration without these actual documents has no fabricated plan/notice baseline.

Teacher feasibility checks in s1 and actual coordination in s2 produce date, activity location, times, general instructions and contact. S3 captures the actual plan manually; native notice fields use those existing confirmed values. S5 retains complete meaning/recipient checks and manual template repair; s7 retains actual response and access resolution.

Test native templates first. S3 removes2.25 provisional hours of repeated plan headings, retaining12.75 actual planning prose; s4 removes2 repeated general-logistics hours, retaining8 notice writing. Ordinary saves are included at full time within writing; real send in s6 keeps1 full hour and is separately gated.
S5 binds exact final notice, attachments and recipients. Any revision returns through s5 before s6. No private pupil needs are merged into a group notice. No new after-activity record is introduced.
research_questions: Can linked notice fields avoid both stale logistics and accidental disclosure of individual support information?

already_counted.description: Feasibility, coordination, substantive plan/notice writing, final release check, send, actual responses and supervision

incremental.description: Maintain plan structure and safe general-logistics notice mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact final parent notice content, attachments and recipients checked in s5; revisions void release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R95.75 gives4.25 gross less1 upkeep=3.25 net; high rounded down3.2. Low1 retains all15 plan-writing hours for a bespoke venue/access plan while compatible confirmed notice fields still remove2 logistics hours less1 upkeep. Actual sends and live work receive no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Remove genuine lookup, duplicate metadata and repeated document fields while retaining game supervision, standardized administration and experiential learning support.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher with fewer actual administrative repetitions and the same responsibility for children's access, safety and meaningful learning.
